summary: Iteration 60 covers Phase-4 accessibility, F-02 canonical daily check-in schema, and F-03 deterministic Benchmark Decision Engine. Backend: 26/26 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iter60_benchmark_decision_and_checkin.py — 13 pure-logic cases for benchmark_decision.decide_benchmark (all 9 branches + determinism + Beginner precedence), plus 5 F-02 end-to-end cases (clean checkin, injury→required, returning→required, equipmentChanged→'your equipment has changed' reason, readiness/today reflects flags), 5 safety-override regression cases (symptoms.illness + chest_pain/severe_dizziness/shortness_of_breath/new_pain all yield safetyOverride=true + Do Not Train + score 0; symptoms.illness also flips gate to required), 2 readiness scoring regression cases (clean check-in returns sensible 0-100 score with safetyOverride=false and readiness/today reflects the latest submission), and a final clean-reset test. Frontend (Expo web, mobile 390x844) after greenlantern login: 15/15 UI checks pass — /checkin renders the new 'Anything changed lately?' section with testIDs flag-injury, flag-returning, flag-equipmentChanged; scales (Energy-5) and symptom-illness chip still work; toggling flag-injury + flag-equipmentChanged and pressing checkin-submit renders the checkin-result card; Profile edit-profile / sign-out / delete-account still open their respective modals (delete-account-modal + edit-profile-modal); Settings page still loads. Greenlantern's daily check-in was explicitly reset to a clean state at the end (safetyOverride=false, all top-level flags false, score 72 Ready to Train).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 4754 lines — flagged in prior iterations, still applies; extracting benchmark_decision.py is a good start, consider moving benchmark/checkin/readiness routes into their own modules next.

In server.py plan-gate handler (line ~1480) 'illness' is read from checkin.get('illness') top-level, which is populated by _both_ symptoms.illness _and_ flags.illness. Correct per spec but not obvious — a docstring on rider_checkin() (already present) is helpful; consider echoing the same note near plan-gate.

GET /api/rider/readiness/today does not require Authorization header (no auth.current_user_id call), yet reads from udb which is user-scoped via the auth dependency middleware. Verified functional, but worth confirming that unauthenticated requests can't leak another user's check-in.
seed_data_creation: Greenlantern's daily_checkins ('latest' + '2026-01-15') was written during tests and explicitly reset to a clean state at the end (symptoms={}, flags={}) so the demo account is not left flagged. No throwaway accounts created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend .env uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). The rider auth bearer token is auto-attached to all /api/* fetches via installFetchAuth() in /app/frontend/src/lib/session.ts, so plain fetch() in feature libs (e.g. src/lib/checkin.ts) still hits authenticated endpoints. greenlantern's own plan is BEGINNER couch-to-road (always yields status='submaximal' from plan-gate); to exercise the non-Beginner branches use plan_id=build-and-climb (Intermediate). daily_checkins docs are keyed by id='latest' AND by ISO date within a per-user scoped DB. Reuse test_iter60_benchmark_decision_and_checkin.py as regression whenever readiness/checkin/plan-gate changes.
